messages:
Nora Q: ReleaseBot blocked publish for redwood/cache:release-2026-03-21-hotfix — error: manifest digest mismatch with provenance signature :confused:
ReleaseBot: publish rejected — signed_digest != registry_digest (signed: sha256:aaab... registry: sha256:cccd...) (policy: require-exact-provenance)
Devon L: That tag was produced by the hotfix job. CI shows successful push, but the registry reported a different manifest after a cross-region replication retry.
BuildBot: note — builder reported a push retry due to a 502 from us-east-1 mirror at 16:02:11Z; retry used same manifest but order of annotations changed slightly
Nora Q: OK, do we force a rebuild or pin? Prefer pin to last-known-good digest that passed E2E. Rebuild risks new regressions.
ReleaseBot: advisory — manual-pin allowed under emergency publish flow. Operator must include `release:manual-pin` and `buildid` in the comment. Manual pins are audited.
Devon L: I'll do a manual put-image pin to sha256:aaab... and add comment: "release:manual-pin reason:replica-retry-annotation-order buildid=20260321-901". Then re-trigger ReleaseBot verify.
Ops Bot: scheduled hold — canary/promote window paused for 30m until manual verification completes. Notifying PMs.
Devon L: ran commands and pinned tag to sha256:aaab... (`aws ecr batch-get-image` + `aws ecr put-image`). Comment added in ReleaseBot UI.
ReleaseBot: verification passed for pinned tag release-2026-03-21-hotfix-pinned — provenance check OK :white_check_mark:
Nora Q: Great. Follow-ups: (1) small CI change to preserve annotation ordering across retries, (2) add a pre-push assert comparing signed digest vs final registry manifest before considering push completed, (3) ops: scan last 2 hours for similar retry events.
Devon L: Opening incident with actions and will paste put-image logs. I'll also open a PR for the pre-push assert.
Nora Q: Add a short note to release notes: "Promotion briefly held; manual pin applied due to manifest digest drift after push retry." Closing when incident + PR are linked.
Devon L: will link both shortly :white_check_mark:
